name: Browser
description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, screenshot.

name: Fetch
description: Retrieve web pages as markdown for the agent to read.

name: GitHub
description: Repos, issues, and pull requests via the official GitHub MCP server.
auth_note: Fine-grained or classic PAT. Also enables git push from sessions.

name: Skills
description: Installed Claude Code-format skills, with progressive disclosure.

name: Web search
description: Web search through your private SearXNG instance — no tracking.

name: Airtable
description: Read and write Airtable bases.
auth_note: Airtable personal access token with the scopes you need.

name: Asana
description: Tasks and projects in Asana.
auth_note: OAuth-only per Asana's docs — paste an OAuth access token. The old /sse endpoint is deprecated (shutdown 05/11/2026); this is the v2 endpoint.

name: Atlassian
description: Jira issues and Confluence pages.
auth_note: OAuth 2.1 is the primary flow (paste an OAuth access token); Atlassian also documents optional API-token auth — see their setup guide.

name: Box
description: Search and query files and enterprise content in Box.
auth_note: OAuth 2.1 only — no API-key auth; paste an OAuth access token minted for a Box app with the MCP integration enabled.

name: ClickUp
description: Tasks, lists, docs, and comments in ClickUp.
auth_note: OAuth-only (public beta) with a vetted client list — personal API keys are rejected; paste an OAuth access token and expect friction outside approved clients.

name: Discord
description: Read channels and send messages through a Discord bot.
auth_note: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; invite the bot to your server with the permissions you want it to have (community server).

name: Gmail
description: Read, search, draft, and send Gmail (community server).
auth_note: Experimental — Google has no public remote MCP. Create a Google Cloud OAuth client (Desktop) with the Gmail API enabled, run `npx @shinzolabs/gmail-mcp auth` once on your own machine to mint a refresh token, then paste all three values here.

name: Linear
description: Issues, projects, and cycles in Linear.
auth_note: Linear API key (Settings → Security & access → API keys) or an OAuth access token — both are accepted as Authorization: Bearer.

name: monday.com
description: Boards and items in monday.com.
auth_note: Personal API token (monday.com → Developers → My access tokens) as bearer, or OAuth 2.1.

name: Notion
description: Search, read, and write Notion pages and databases.
auth_note: Internal integration secret from notion.so/profile/integrations; share the target pages with the integration. (Notion's hosted mcp.notion.com is OAuth-only, so Forge runs the official local server instead.)

name: Slack
description: Read channels, threads, and DMs; posting is off until you allow it.
auth_note: Set a user token (xoxp) or a bot token (xoxb) from a Slack app — user tokens unlock search; bots must be invited to channels. Message posting stays disabled unless the third field is set.

name: Todoist
description: Tasks, projects, and filters in Todoist.
auth_note: Todoist API token (Settings → Integrations → Developer) sent as bearer; OAuth is also supported.

name: Zapier
description: Trigger thousands of app actions through your Zapier MCP endpoint.
auth_note: Zapier issues a per-account MCP URL (credentials embedded) — paste it here.

name: Cloudflare docs
description: Search Cloudflare's documentation.
auth_note: No auth needed — public docs server.

name: Hugging Face
description: Search models, datasets, spaces, and papers on the Hub.
auth_note: Works anonymously; add a token for private/gated repos.

name: Netlify
description: Create, deploy, and manage Netlify sites and env vars.
auth_note: Netlify PAT (User settings → OAuth → New access token). The official local server is used because Netlify's remote MCP is OAuth-only.

name: Sentry
description: Query errors, issues, and traces from your Sentry org.
auth_note: OAuth-only per Sentry's docs — paste an OAuth access token; plain user auth tokens are not documented to work here.

name: Supabase
description: Query databases, manage migrations, and inspect Supabase projects.
auth_note: Personal access token (supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens) as bearer — documented for CI use; OAuth login is the interactive default.

name: Vercel
description: Projects, deployments, logs, and docs search on Vercel.
auth_note: OAuth-only, and Vercel only approves reviewed MCP clients — no API-token auth; some tools (docs search) work without authentication.

name: Canva
description: Create and edit Canva designs.
auth_note: OAuth-only — Canva's MCP authenticates via its OAuth consent flow.

name: Higgsfield
description: Generate images, video, and audio with Higgsfield's AI models.
auth_note: OAuth-only — the hosted MCP signs in with your Higgsfield account (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, no API-key path); paste an OAuth access token. Generations spend your Higgsfield plan credits.

name: Figma
description: Read designs, components, and variables from Figma files.
auth_note: OAuth-only — the remote server authenticates via Figma's OAuth flow; personal access tokens are not documented to work.

name: HubSpot
description: CRM contacts, companies, deals, and tickets in HubSpot.
auth_note: Private app access token (Settings → Integrations → Private apps). The official local server is used because HubSpot's remote MCP is OAuth-only.

name: Intercom
description: Conversations and customer data from Intercom.
auth_note: Intercom access token (Developer Hub app) as bearer, or OAuth. EU-hosted workspaces should use https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp via a custom connector.

name: PayPal
description: Invoices, payments, and disputes via PayPal's MCP.
auth_note: OAuth access token generated from your PayPal app's client ID + secret (developer.paypal.com), passed as bearer.

name: Plaid
description: Inspect Plaid integrations and API usage.
auth_note: OAuth client-credentials token (scope mcp:dashboard) as bearer — tokens expire after ~15 minutes, so expect frequent re-auth.

name: Square
description: Payments, catalog, and customers in Square.
auth_note: OAuth is the documented flow for the remote server — paste an OAuth access token; developer-dashboard access tokens are not documented to work here.

name: Stripe
description: Customers, invoices, payments, and docs search.
auth_note: Restricted API key as bearer is officially supported (recommended for agents); OAuth is the interactive default.
